ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is an upper six-membered nitrogen-containing aromatic ring, with one N in the ring; this N is connected downward to a lower benzene ring. The right side of the upper ring is connected to an amino N, this N is also connected to R, and an N-H bond is labeled. There are two nitro substituents on the lower benzene ring, drawn respectively as O2N and NO2. Curved arrows are also drawn in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring arrows. Then reason: According to the specified method, divide the structure into parts and count only the visible bonds between heavy atoms, excluding bonds involving hydrogen. The upper nitrogen-containing aromatic ring has 6 ring bonds; the lower benzene ring has 6 ring bonds. Additional connecting bonds include: the single bond from the upper ring N to the lower benzene ring, the bond from the upper ring to the right-side amino N, and the bond from the amino N to R, 3 in total. Each of the two nitro groups counts the aryl-N bond plus two N-O bonds, that is 3 each, 6 for the two. Exclude the N-H bond and arrows. Therefore the total is 6 + 6 + 3 + 6 = 21.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Partition the image into components and count visible heavy-atom bonds once in each component. Count 6 bonds around the upper heteroaromatic ring and 6 bonds around the lower benzene ring. Add the single bond from the upper-ring N to the lower ring, the bond from the upper ring to the right-side amine N, and the N-R bond: 3 more. For each of the two nitro groups, count the aryl-N bond plus the two N-O bonds, giving 3 per nitro group and 6 total. Exclude the N-H bond and arrows. Sum 6+6+3+6 = 21.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中有一个上方六元含氮芳香环，环内有一个N；该N向下连接到一个下方苯环。上方环的右侧连接到一个胺基N，该N还连接R，并标有一个N-H键。下方苯环上有两个硝基取代基，分别画作O2N和NO2。图中还画有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。

再推理：按指定方法把结构分成部分并只数重原子之间的可见键，排除涉及氢的键。上方含氮芳香环有6个环键；下方苯环有6个环键。额外连接键包括：上方环N到下方苯环的单键、上方环到右侧胺N的键、胺N到R的键，共3个。两个硝基各计芳基-N键加两个N-O键，即每个3个，两个共6个。排除N-H键和箭头。因此总数为6 + 6 + 3 + 6 = 21。
